usedFor: LiveChat holds your conversations and Anthropic Claude writes text, so “New Chat” can run “Generate Response” with the conversation.

bestTemplate.name: “New Chat” in LiveChat, then “Generate Response” in Anthropic Claude
bestTemplate.why: Each chat that starts gets a drafted reply from the model, ready for your team to review.

watchOut: “Generate Response” only writes text, so sending it to a customer still waits in Needs you for approval.
